Synopsis:
For when a player interacts with the trial statue to being the path of darkness/invisible platform trial.

Cluster Contexts:
- SHA_PathOfDarknessTrial.json: The player is inspecting a Shar statue to initiate the Path of Darkness — the invisible‑platform trial that forces you to navigate by touch, memory, or limited light. The statue holds a bowl with an ancient, rust‑coloured bloodstain: a neat, deliberate disc that marks past ritual offerings and underscores the shrine’s Shar‑worship context. Off‑screen tension is high from recent events (a drider ambush, Harpers converging over a moonlantern, and nearby cult/guard patrols), so nearby allies, lanterns, or suspicious Harpers can affect how the scene plays out. Expect the trial to alter movement and visibility (shadowed gaps, unseen platforms) and to interact with the wider shadow/tadpole crisis and any light sources you carry.
- SHA_ObjectOfDarknessTrial.json: The player is in a Shar temple, examining a statue whose bowl bears an ancient, rust‑coloured bloodstain—a ritual offering that, when interacted with, begins a stealth trial tied to the shrine. Off‑screen there has recently been violent activity (a drider ambush and related encounters) and the region is on high alert: Harper patrols are nearby, the moonlantern is a contested item, and Last Light Inn is a known refuge. How Harpers and other forces react depends on prior choices (for example whether you fought the cult, surrendered or kept the moonlantern, or have ties to rescued prisoners), so triggering the trial could draw scrutiny or force you into stealth to avoid detection. This summary assumes the wider shadow/Absolute crisis and heightened suspicion described in the cluster contexts.
- SHA_DoublesEncounterTrial.json: You stand before a Shar statue in a temple chamber; the bowl it holds contains an old, rust‑coloured bloodstain and the statue’s disembodied voice can invite you into a combat trial of devotion. Shadowheart has a personal lens on this scene—some narration and visuals are delivered only for her, signalling her special connection or stake in the ritual. Interacting with the bowl can prompt choices like cutting yourself to begin the trial, inspecting the statue, or walking away, any of which may trigger the double combat challenge or end the encounter. Off‑screen the region is tense (recent ambushes/drider fights, Harpers and moonlanterns nearby, and the Last Light refuge), so nearby forces and allies may react to violence or ritual activity and influence immediate consequences.
- SHA_Disc_Altar.json: The player is standing before an altar to Shar inside her temple, where a disembodied Voice of Shar monitors their progress and offers modular commentary on the trials and rituals observed so far. The party has already advanced through earlier challenges and reached the inner-threshold; the voice now frames a deliberate choice—stepping into a pool of water to begin the final test to enter the sanctum. Shadowheart (a companion) notes that nothing further can be done until the trials are completed. An inscription and the voice suggest the trials emphasize stealth, martial skill, and devotion (and even hint at a Selûnite blood sacrifice), and the player may or may not recall that Dark Justiciars are Shar’s elite inner circle.
- SHA_Trials_PAD_ObjectOfDarknessHint.json: The player speaks up on entering one of the trial areas in the temple of Shar. If they had previously read a book in the library area, they'll have an idea of what they need to do (navigate the maze and get through the locked door on the far side without being detected/setting off a trap). Otherwise they'll be none the wiser.

Dialogue Excerpts (up to 3 samples, ordered):
Sample 1:
- Narrator: *The bowl contains an ancient, rust-coloured bloodstain. It forms a neat disc, as if spilled calmly and willingly.* || [context] CinematicNodeContext: The player looks at a large bowl being held by a Shar statue.  Close-up of a dried blood stain in the base of the bowl. (node 1)

Sample 2:
- Narrator: *The bowl contains an ancient, rust-coloured bloodstain. It forms a neat disc, as if spilled calmly and willingly.* || [context] CinematicNodeContext: The player looks at a large bowl being held by a Shar statue.  Close-up of a dried blood stain in the base of the bowl. (node 1)

Sample 3:
- Narrator: *Another bowl, bearing the stains of an ancient blood offering.* || [context] CinematicNodeContext: The player looks at a large bowl being held by a Shar statue.  Close-up of a dried blood stain in the base of the bowl. (node 14)

The trial changes movement and visibility (shadowed gaps, unseen platforms) and will interact with any light sources you carry and the wider shadow/tadpole crisis. Off‑screen the area is on edge after recent violence (a drider ambush and related fights); Harpers, cultists, and guards are nearby and may react to ritual activity, so allies, lanterns, or suspicious Harpers can alter how the scene plays out.
